::: {.hero}
# Markets, measured.

A hobby research site. Each question gets a naive baseline to beat, a stated
uncertainty, and an honest answer, including when the answer is "it didn't work".
:::

::: {.notice}
**Not financial advice.** Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell anything.
This site makes no trades and gives no signals.
:::

[Experiment · live]{.tag .live}

### NVIDIA predictor

Can machine learning beat naive baselines at predicting whether NVDA closes up or
down the next day? Models are tested on two decades of history and then scored
daily on predictions they cannot take back.

[Open the experiment →](experiments/nvidia.qmd){.card-link}
:::

## How to read this site

Every experiment follows the same rules, set out on the [Method](method.qmd) page:
baselines first, no peeking at the future, costs included, and uncertainty shown
next to every number.
